lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct high-contrast vertical white lines are visible on the lateral flank; spacing is relatively uniform in the mid-torso with increased frequency and narrower gaps observed toward the posterior section.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation observed on the third line segment from the posterior, splitting approximately 20% down from the dorsal crest.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first two anterior lines and the final posterior line are abbreviated, terminating before reaching the lower ventral line of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density cluster of 3-4 distinct white spots is visible on the upper haunch area, situated between the final vertical line and the tail base.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the upper hind limb align horizontally, forming a short geometric axis parallel to the dorsal line.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking between the eyes; two white spots on the lower cheek/mandible area; dark dorsal crest extending from neck to tail; white transverse band visible on the lower section of the front right limb.
